turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I'm here because my manager at the restaurant told me I needed to see someone. I don't really know why I did it, but it freaked them out.
